headline: WATCH gets a thumb: title-screen button, 44pt pill, pause-menu row
lede: #1656 shipped the phone answer to "can't hit Y": a big solid ▶ WATCH on the title screen starts the run and the proven route itself, the in-play pill grew past Apple's 44pt thumb rule in solid emerald, and watched titles now offer WATCH right in the pause menu. A new browser-free gate (watchphonecheck, 244 checks, mutant-proven) runs in CI on every PR.

notes.text: Attract ▶ WATCH on 29 titles — one tap starts AND watches (Zork/IronRing/Gauntlet/FourHalls skipped honestly: no attract screen or hero-select in between).
FloorBoss's pill was sitting under the left thumb-stick; lifted clear of the pad band.
watchphonecheck joins the static CI job: every title's phone-WATCH contract proven in Node, ~1 s, no Chrome needed.
Pixel pass at 390×844 still needs a healthy browser — filed as #1667 for the QA lane.
